description: Election Commission : Vacation of the Office of members of Angunakolapellessa and Katuwana Pradeshiya Sabhas
categorisation: This gazette content concerns the vacation of office by members of local authorities (Pradeshiya Sabhas) due to ceasing to be members of a political party, as declared by a Returning Officer under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. This directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials, fitting the definition of an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
